name: flow-day-night-toggle
title: Day and Night
description: Bật chế độ tối: núm mặt trời lăn sang vừa xoay, tia nắng thu lại thành mặt trăng khuyết, bầu trời xanh tắt, mây chìm xuống và sao lần lượt bật lên.

credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Track 140x60 (radius 30); knob r15 moves x +80 px with rotation 0 → 135° over 0.6 s power2.inOut (0.3-0.9 s). Sun: 8 rays shrink 6 → 0 px over the first half; from 40 % the knob tints to night and the crescent is a sky-coloured circle r13 sliding in. Sky blue overlay 55 % → 0; two clouds sink 26 px and fade (0.1 apart); 5 stars pop (back.out) at 35 % + 10 % each of progress. Reverse at 1.7 s. Params: duration (0.6 s, power2.inOut) · travel (80 px) · rotate (135°) · stars (5). The knob rolls 80 units turning 135°; the rays shrink in the first half, the crescent slides in from 40 %, clouds sink and five stars pop.
